files.setting-draft/ruleset-files/runtime/rule:
sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
  - name: Intrusion
    description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
  - name: Field Medicine
    description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.active_actor}
  actor_entities: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.entities}
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values: [player]
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: string
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
      - name: charge_cost
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: multiplier
        type: integer
        required: true
      - name: family
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - add_stress
          - clear_interference
        required: true
    effects:
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_cost
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.name
          value: program
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.result
          value: amount * multiplier
      - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.conditions.interference
              value: false
      - condition: family == 'add_stress'
        on_true:
          - increment:
              field: state.stress
              amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
      - name: skill
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - intrusion
          - field_medicine
      - name: pressure
        type: integer
        required: true
    effects:
      - dice:
          expression: 2d6
        store_as: _operation_roll
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.skill
          value: skill
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.total
          value: _operation_roll.total
      - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: clear
        on_false:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
      - name: stress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: wounds
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: charge_spent
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: progress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
    effects:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: stress
      - increment:
          field: state.wounds
          amount: wounds
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_spent
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: true
      - increment:
          field: state.advancement.intrusion
          amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - ghost_route
          - signal_boost
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
    effects:
      - table_lookup:
          table: definitions.programs
          key: program
          required: true
          exact_selector: true
        store_as: _definition
      - set:
          field: _definition_key
          value: program
      - set:
          field: _definition_table
          value: programs
      - call: commit_program
        params:
          program: "{program}"
          amount: "{amount}"
          charge_cost: "{_definition.charge_cost}"
          multiplier: "{_definition.multiplier}"
          family: "{_definition.family}"
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 5}
          multiplier: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 5}
        required: [charge_cost, multiplier]
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 5}
          multiplier: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 5}
        required: [charge_cost, multiplier]
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

catalog.title: Rift Awakening
catalog.summary: Wake beneath an unfamiliar sky in a woodland clearing. A weathered sign points toward Thornwall. Explore your surroundings and choose your first steps in the Severed Lands.

catalog.title: Last Cart Through
catalog.summary: A broken Guild wagon blocks a forest crossing. Its driver needs help while a hungry Rifthound watches from the treeline.

catalog.title: The Quarry Turns
catalog.summary: A Rift-touched boar has made a supply trail impassable. Choose your ground before the hunt becomes a charge.

catalog.title: Hold the Rope
catalog.summary: A surveyor hangs below a Cairnfields crossing. Clear the approach, then keep the rescue line intact.

catalog.title: Dead Inventory
catalog.summary: A recovered suit of Warden armour wakes during an Athenaeum stocktake. Get the porters out before the storeroom becomes wreckage.

catalog.title: The Sparring Debt
catalog.summary: A Lodge trainee owes the town an exhibition. Stand in for two friendly bouts and give the audience something worth remembering.

catalog.title: No One Left Below
catalog.summary: A salvage crew is trapped in a Hollows cellar. Open a way in, then bring them out before the district shifts.

catalog.title: The Cartographer’s Wake
catalog.summary: At a Nexus cartographer's wake, the final chart is missing. A broken cellar latch and a witness's account offer the first leads.

catalog.title: A Light on Breathing Street
catalog.summary: An amber lamp burns upstairs in a townhouse newly returned to the Hollows. A local scavenger asks for help recovering a family keepsake.

catalog.title: The Honest Thief
catalog.summary: At a Thornwall forge, two unpaid workers present pay chits and a rough sketch of a counting-house. Decide whether and how to help reclaim their wages.

catalog.title: The Bell Below
catalog.summary: A warning bell fell into an old Warden workhouse after a salvage platform collapsed. Crews offer payment and equipment for its recovery.

catalog.title: The Long Way Round
catalog.summary: A Guild supply caravan is overdue in the Verdant Margin. At a roadside post, a courier shows its last known trail and offers a rescue contract.

catalog.title: A Debt in Iron
catalog.summary: As Lodge trainee Tavin Bell, begin beside a missing-relic notice and your signed pledge. Quarterkeeper Ysra asks for a Warden survey plate's return and an honest account.

catalog.title: The Scavengers’ Accord
catalog.summary: Two salvage crews claim the same newly returned Hollows storehouse. Rift-touched predators occupy its entrance route, and both crews offer to pay for scouting.

catalog.title: The Company of the Lost
catalog.summary: At a Hollows staging yard, a patron offers a paid trial recovery from a newly returned storehouse. Meet available workers and decide how to approach the job.

catalog.title: The Map of Tomorrow
catalog.summary: In a Nexus map room, two charts disagree about a Cairnfields approach. A sponsor offers a survey contract and equipment for checking the route.

catalog.title: Riichi Quick Test
catalog.summary: Take the open seat, choose East-only or East-South, and play one friendly Riichi match. Player included; no character building required.
